long_biography.plain_text:
Herzog entered Swiss motor racing in the late 1960s and moved from BMW touring cars to a Ferrari 512M in the World Sportscar Championship. At Brands Hatch in 1971, he and Herbert Müller finished fourth against factory-backed opposition. He also drove at Le Mans and later returned as an IMSA team owner and driver.

Away from the circuit, Herzog founded Alucraft and worked with designer Alberto Mercati on aluminium yachts including Texas, Galaxy, Adler and Baroness. Naval architect Sergio Cutolo later credited him with helping develop the explorer-yacht concept through converted working vessels. Herzog also maintained business interests in road freight, warehousing and shipping. He remained associated with historic racing and ambitious yacht projects into later life.
